name: writing-honest-claims
title_zh: 分析结论先过证据关，再落笔的措辞守门员
tagline_zh: 写报告总被质疑「数据撑不住这句话」？它把结论分成观察/方向/决策三级，超纲词自动拦下，连「导致」都不许乱写。
tagline_en: Tired of reports that overclaim? It grades each sentence as observed/directional/decision-support, blocks causal.
desc_en: Writes findings in language the evidence can carry — the claim ladder (observed → directional → decision-support, never causal without a design), effect sizes over drama, banned phrasings. Use when writing any conclusion, report section, playbook, or public page from analysis results.
why_zh: 不是查重，是给每句话称重——证据能扛多少就写多少，因果没设计就降级为相关，戏剧化措辞直接标红。
why_en: It's a claim ladder, not a thesaurus: every phrase must match the evidence tier, so 'causes' won't slip past unless your design.
limit_zh: 只处理分析结果的文字表述，不校验数据本身；需要你提供结论草稿或要点；不生成新分析，只改写现有文本。
limit_en: Only polishes wording of existing analysis text; no data validation, no new stats. You must supply draft conclusions or bullet points.
title_en: A wording gatekeeper that checks your claims against.
